capabilities: Chat with local AI CLI agents in a sidebar
Switch provider, model and reasoning effort
Attach the active note, selection, or a context file or folder
Open file:// links from responses in Obsidian or the system editor
Copy or insert responses and code blocks into notes
disambiguation: Not a sidecar-file generator; it is a chat sidebar that runs local AI CLI tools.
extras: Desktop-only: it spawns local CLI processes and cannot run on mobile. Build-from-source, manual install and BRAT beta instructions are in a separate guide.
motivation: The author wanted to connect the vault to the command-line agents already running on the machine and reuse existing subscriptions rather than manage paid API tokens or proxies.
problem: AI chat plugins typically require paid API tokens, proxy configuration, or pasting secret keys into plugin settings.

relations.evidence: Google Antigravity: run agy in your terminal.
GitHub Copilot: run copilot login in your terminal.
Claude Code: run claude (or install via Anthropic / npm) and authenticate.
OpenAI Codex: install via npm install -g @openai/codex and run codex login.
Pi Coding Agent: install via npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent and run pi.

requires.name: Login or subscription for the chosen CLI provider

summary: Chat sidebar that sends prompts to locally installed, already-authenticated AI CLI tools instead of API keys.
